name: GeoNet Quakes
description: Ingests recent earthquakes at or above a configurable Modified Mercalli Intensity from the GeoNet Quake API and posts them to the map as earthquake epicentre points with magnitude, intensity, depth and NZ local time details.

permissions.description: Submits earthquake epicentre points to CloudTAK

schedule.description: Polls the GeoNet Quake API for recent earthquakes on a schedule.
